description_en: Adds IP addresses to the whitelist of a listener
description_zh: 添加监听访问控制白名单
kebab_example: aliyun slb add-listener-white-list-item --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --load-balancer-id lb-bp1o94dp5i6ea0000000 --listener-port 80 --source-items 192.168.XX.XX --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddListenerWhiteListItem

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance is created.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
负载均衡实例所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CLB instance
parameters.name: load_balancer_id

parameters.help_en: The frontend port that is used by the CLB instance
parameters.help_zh: 负载均衡实例前端使用的端口
parameters.name: listener_port

parameters.help_en:
The IP addresses or CIDR blocks that you want to add to the whitelist.

This parameter takes effect when the AccessControlStatus parameter of the listener is set to open_white_list.

Separate multiple IP addresses or CIDR blocks with commas (,).

You cannot enter 0.0.0.0 or 0.0.0.0/0. To disable access control, you can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27599.html operation to set the value of the AccessControlStatus parameter to close
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制列表。

监听的AccessControlStatus为open_white_list时有效。

支持输入IP地址或IP地址段（CIDR block形式），多个IP地址或地址段用半角逗号（,）分割。

不允许输入0.0.0.0或0.0.0.0/0。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27599.html接口将**AccessControlStatus**的值设置为**close**来关闭访问控制
parameters.name: source_items

parameters.help_en:
The frontend protocol that is used by the CLB instance.

This parameter is required when listeners that use different protocols listen on the same port
parameters.help_zh:
负载均衡实例前端使用的协议。

相同端口存在不同协议监听时，此字段必填
parameters.name: listener_protocol
